about_the_game:
Death is not an end for you. It is a command.

You walk through worlds where gods have fallen silent, where civilizations lie in ruin, where life itself has turned to dust. You are a warrior… but not of flesh and blood. Your body is made of ash, your eyes see into the void, and your purpose is born of divine decree.

The creatures that once haunted the living are now your resource. Defeating them is not the end—it's the beginning. Bind their souls, summon their bodies, and turn fallen enemies into loyal soldiers. Every encounter is a new piece for your army. Every death holds potential.

Necromancer’s Last Stand is a dark fantasy action game forged with deadly, tactical soulslike combat. Each battle is a deadly dance where your reflexes, strategy, and decisions are pushed to their limits. Every fight you survive isn’t just survival—it’s an opportunity to grow stronger.

Steal your enemies’ abilities, evolve them, craft deadly combinations, and dominate the battlefield. Make an armored demon your frontline tank, or transform a cursed mage into a walking storm of destruction. The choice is yours. The strategy is yours. The army is yours.

From the ashes, you will forge a new order. As you carry out your god’s final command, you will bring every shattered world to its knees—and turn every war into a new beginning.

You are a skeleton.
But what they should fear... is what marches behind you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10-11
  • Processor: INTEL CORE I5-8400 or AMD RYZEN 3 3300X
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GEFORCE GTX 1060 3 GB or AMD RADEON RX 580 4 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: windows 10-11
  • Processor: NTEL CORE I7-8700K or AMD RYZEN 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GEFORCE GTX 1070 8 GB or AMD RADEON RX VEGA 56 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 35 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
